sandboxHelp.title: The sandbox is not available
sandboxHelp.body: This system blocks a security feature that {product} uses to keep websites isolated from each other and from your computer. {product} does not open websites without it.
sandboxHelp.fixHint: Needs your administrator password. {product} restarts afterwards.
sandboxHelp.packages: Get the deb or rpm package instead
sandboxHelp.failed: The sandbox could not be allowed. Please try the deb or rpm package.
newtab.title: New tab
settings.title: Settings
settings.searchUrlHint: An https address with %s where the search terms go.
settings.searchUrlInvalid: Enter an https address that contains %s.
settings.setupGuideNote: Choose the look, the tabs and the search engine step by step.
setup.title: Set up {product}
setup.welcome.title: Welcome to {product}
setup.welcome.body: Make {product} yours in a few steps: choose how it looks, where your tabs go and how you search. Every choice applies at once, and you can change it later in the settings.
setup.look.title: Choose your look
setup.look.body: Pick light or dark colors, or follow your system, and an accent color for buttons and highlights.
setup.layout.title: Arrange your tabs
setup.layout.body: Keep the tabs in a row above or below the page, or as a list at the side, which leaves room for many tabs.
setup.search.title: Pick your search engine
setup.search.body: The address bar and the new tab page search with it.
setup.done.title: You are all set
setup.done.body: {product} keeps your choices. To change them, open Settings from the menu at the right end of the toolbar.
settings.contentBlockerNote: Uses the filter lists that uBlock Origin enables by default, which also block known malware sites.
shell.blockerOff: Content blocker: off on this site
history.title: History
history.clearConfirm: Remove every page from the history?
bookmarks.title: Bookmarks
bookmarks.name: Name
bookmarks.invalidAddress: Enter an address that starts with http:// or https://.
import.title: Import from another browser
import.note: Bookmarks go into a folder of their own, which a later import of the same browser replaces. Open tabs open in new windows.
import.failed: Some data could not be read; close {browser} and try again.
import.none: No other browsers found on this computer.
import.managed: Your organization turned off the import.
setup.import.title: Bring your bookmarks along
setup.import.body: Import bookmarks and history from the browser you used so far. It stays as it is, and you can import later in the settings, too.
